description: Hire a specific human. Funding defaults to your wallet: it reserves existing wallet funds including fees, without checkout or auto-top-up. A short wallet returns insufficient_wallet_funds and required/available/shortfall cents; add funds and retry the same request. Pass a stable idempotencyKey to retry safely; without one, the hire is keyed by its terms, so an identical request returns the same hire. Wallet retries return the same hire, including after cancellation; changed inputs or a repeat hire on the same terms need a new key. Pass fundingMethod: checkout for a hosted checkout instead: it returns checkoutUrl for the account owner to pay, and the hire is funded and the human assigned only after payment. Each checkout call starts a new hire and checkout link. If checkout returns status insufficient_funds, add wallet funds and retry without fundingMethod and with a new idempotencyKey; profile_country_required means set your country at setupUrl first. Funding holds escrow and does not pay the worker. After work, use confirm_delivery and release_payment. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

estimatedHours.description: Hours of work, at least 0.083 (5 minutes); defaults to 1
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

fundingMethod.description: Defaults to wallet, which spends existing wallet funds. Pass checkout for a hosted checkout link instead.

humanId.description: Profile ID of the human to hire
humanId.title: minLength(1)

idempotencyKey.description: 1-200 characters. Reuse it only to retry the same hire. Without it, a wallet hire is keyed by its terms, so an identical request returns the same hire.
idempotencyKey.title: maxLength(200)

price.description: Worker pay in USD, 1-10,000; fees are added on top
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

taskDescription.description: What to do, at least 10 characters
taskDescription.title: minLength(10)

name: rent_human
title: Hire a human
